name: Shafiqur Rahman
contribution: He led Jamaat-e-Islami into the 2026 election cycle and became the party's main public face in the Jamaat-led alliance that included the NCP.
context: Bangladesh's 2026 national election campaign and the Jamaat-led opposition bloc.
impact: His leadership made Jamaat a central force in the 13th parliamentary election and in post-election opposition politics.
highlight: The Jamaat chief became one of the decisive figures in the election's opposition bloc.
seoTitle: Shafiqur Rahman: Jamaat-e-Islami Leader in Bangladesh Politics
seoDescription: Explore Shafiqur Rahman’s role as Ameer of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami and his place in the party’s 2026 election campaign and opposition alliance.
shortAnswer: Shafiqur Rahman is the Ameer of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami and a leading figure in the party’s 2026 electoral and opposition politics.
